name: todo-webapp
description: The single-page React application signed-in users interact with to manage their personal todo list: create, edit, complete, reopen, delete, tag, and filter/sort tasks by tag, due date, and priority. Handles sign-in via Thunder OIDC/PKCE and calls todo-api for all task data. Does not store task data itself and holds no secrets.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Backend API for creating, editing, completing, and querying the signed-in user's tasks.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client used for browser sign-in (PKCE); provides the SPA's public client id and issuer URLs.
